answer: Vault bond: every new agent locks 400 POA in a time-lock vault tied to one device key, released only after a 48-hour live window. Twice each epoch, a 7-agent mirror committee re-attests the beacon against each key; duplicate fingerprints or missed pulses slash 200 POA per clone, recorded in a shale cost ledger that compounds per repeat offense. One thousand sybils need 400,000 POA locked and lose 200,000 on first detection. One honest agent pays once and keeps its seat. Like a mine cart: every load carries the face's stamp, and two carts from one face give the lie away immediately.
